result.description:
K8 Building Tech Pty Ltd offers market-leading solutions and products for the commercial and residential construction sectors, specialising in thermal, acoustic and fire-rated building systems. Working with leading manufacturers and suppliers, we deliver high-quality building solutions for projects ranging from single residential dwellings to Tier 1 commercial developments.

Due to continued business growth, K8 Building Tech Pty Ltd is seeking a dedicated full-time Procurement Specialist to enhance procurement effectiveness across the business. The role will provide strategic advice to management on sourcing strategies, supplier performance, procurement processes, inventory optimisation and continuous improvement initiatives. This position is based at our head office in Port Melbourne, Victoria.

Base salary: $79,423 (plus super)

Main tasks include:
•	Analyse procurement requirements, demand forecasts and inventory information to develop sourcing strategies and purchasing plans that support business objectives.
•	Source, assess and recommend suppliers by evaluating pricing, product quality, lead times, service capability and overall commercial value.
•	Manage supplier relationships and support commercial negotiations relating to pricing, supply arrangements and procurement terms.
•	Monitor supplier performance, procurement expenditure and purchasing trends to identify cost-saving opportunities, manage supply risks and improve procurement outcomes.
•	Prepare procurement reports and provide insights and recommendations to management regarding procurement performance, supplier management and inventory optimisation.
•	Develop, implement and maintain procurement policies, procedures, documentation and governance frameworks to support consistent and compliant procurement practices.
•	Support the optimisation and ongoing use of MYOB Acumatica ERP to improve procurement processes, inventory visibility and business reporting capabilities.
•	Analyse procurement processes and performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities, enhance efficiency and strengthen supply chain outcomes.
•	Work collaboratively with sales, warehouse and management teams to align procurement strategies with customer demand, inventory requirements and operational priorities.
•	Support contract administration activities by maintaining supplier agreements, commercial documentation and procurement records.
Required Qualifications and Experience:
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics, Operations Management or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management or commercial procurement.
•	Experience within construction materials, building products, manufacturing or wholesale distribution industries is highly regarded.

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Knowledge of ERP systems such as MYOB Acumatica, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365.
•	Strong analytical and commercial acumen.
•	Contract administration and negotiation skills.
•	Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and organisational skills.

Full-time Activities Coordinator position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Campsie, NSW 2194. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Activities Coordinator
•	$79,000 – $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Work in a professional allied health environment.

Position Overview:
Integrated Fitness is an allied health and rehabilitation provider specialising in evidence-based exercise, therapeutic recreation and wellness programs designed by accredited Exercise Physiologists. The organisation supports NDIS participants, Workers Compensation clients, people living with diabetes and other chronic health conditions, helping clients improve their independence, participation and overall quality of life.

As an Activities Coordinator, you will plan, coordinate and deliver therapeutic recreation and leisure programs that complement exercise physiology and rehabilitation services. Working closely with the allied health team, you will support clients to achieve improved physical, psychological, emotional, social and spiritual wellbeing through person-centred activities.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Plan, coordinate and implement therapeutic recreation and leisure programs that support rehabilitation, independence and quality of life for clients.
•	Assess clients' interests, functional abilities, rehabilitation goals and support needs in collaboration with Exercise Physiologists and other allied health professionals.
•	Develop individualised activity programs for NDIS participants, Workers Compensation clients, people living with diabetes and individuals managing chronic health conditions.
•	Deliver individual and group therapeutic activities that promote physical, cognitive, psychological, emotional, social and spiritual wellbeing.
•	Modify activity programs according to clients' progress, mobility, health status and therapeutic goals.
•	Monitor client participation, evaluate program outcomes and maintain accurate documentation and progress records.
•	Encourage community participation, social engagement and confidence-building through structured recreational and wellness activities.
•	Work collaboratively with Exercise Physiologists and the multidisciplinary team to ensure activity programs complement rehabilitation and exercise interventions.
•	Prepare, organise and maintain therapeutic activity resources and ensure all activities comply with workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Build positive relationships with clients, families, carers and external support providers to encourage ongoing participation and wellbeing.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an Activities Coordinator, Diversional Therapist or similar.
•	Knowledge of person-centred therapeutic recreation and rehabilitation practices.
•	Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary allied health environment.
•	Excellent communication, organisational and documentation skills.
•	Understanding of NDIS, Workers Compensation and community-based rehabilitation services.
•	Ability to adapt activities to suit clients with varying physical, cognitive and psychosocial support needs.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $79,000 to $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply:
11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.
